_comment: Per-ISP DPI-evasion presets (Iran, 2025-2026 field reports). 'auto' is the safe default. Each preset maps onto the enhanced SNI profile fields: method (technique combination), fooling (TCP-level invalidity injected into decoy packets), repeats (decoy packet count), seqovl (multisplit overlapping-sequence offset), split_pos (byte position of the first split), midsld (split at the middle of the SNI 'sld' label), fingerprint (uTLS-style ClientHello shape). The panel applies a preset to its profile; the client helper executes it.

auto.label: Auto (recommended)
auto.description: Combined decoy + fragmentation with md5sig fooling — the best average across Iranian ISPs.

irancell_mci.label: Irancell / MCI (همراه اول)
irancell_mci.description: fake,multidisorder split-pos=1,midsld fooling=md5sig repeats=6 — best for mobile carriers.

mokhaberat_shatel.label: Mokhaberat / Shatel (مخابرات و شاتل)
mokhaberat_shatel.description: multisplit split-seqovl=568 split-pos=1 fooling=ts repeats=6 — for fixed-line ISPs.

hard.label: Hard operators (اپراتورهای سختگیرتر)
hard.description: fake,fakedsplit fooling=ts repeats=6 fakedsplit-pattern=0x00 — most aggressive decoy set.
